gram_case.label: case
gram_case.meaning: The inflectional relation of an entire nominal to its construction.

gram_ending.label: ending
gram_ending.meaning: A bound form at the right edge of its host.

gram_clause.label: clause

gram_finite.label: finite

gram_chart.label: paradigm chart
gram_chart.meaning: An ordered display of contrasting linguistic forms.

gram_aspect.label: aspect
gram_aspect.meaning: The presentation of an eventuality as ongoing, completed or considered as a whole.
gram_aspect.status: Technical sense introduced in this grammar

gram_stress.label: stress
gram_stress.meaning: Prosodic prominence on part of a spoken form.
gram_stress.status: Technical sense introduced in this grammar

gram_head.label: grammatical head
gram_head.meaning: The constituent determining the role or distribution of a larger expression.
gram_head.status: Technical sense introduced in this grammar

reg_readout.label: instrument reading
reg_readout.meaning: A mark or value shown by an instrument on a given reading. It may differ from the quantity being estimated.
reg_readout.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_resolution.label: measurement resolution
reg_resolution.meaning: The smallest difference in the measured quantity that produces a discernible change in indication under the stated conditions.
reg_resolution.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_counterexample.label: counterexample
reg_counterexample.meaning: A case satisfying a proposed rule’s premises while failing its conclusion.
reg_counterexample.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_clearance.label: mechanical clearance
reg_clearance.meaning: Space between mating parts that permits intended movement. The relevant surfaces must be specified.
reg_clearance.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_altitude.label: angular altitude
reg_altitude.meaning: Angular elevation relative to the local horizon. A linear height would require a different expression.
reg_altitude.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_azimuth.label: azimuth angle
reg_azimuth.meaning: A direction measured around the local horizon from a stated zero in a stated sense.
reg_azimuth.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_parallax.label: parallax
reg_parallax.meaning: An apparent displacement relative to a background caused by changing the observing position.
reg_parallax.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar

reg_phenophase.label: phenophase
reg_phenophase.meaning: An observable seasonal stage or activity of an organism. An observer may record its presence, absence, or uncertainty.
reg_phenophase.status: Technical sense proposed in the specialist-register chapters of this grammar
